as_of_note: Compiled 2026-11-11 by the UAE source-audit lane (iteration 19, Wave A). CONTEXT ONLY: never a scoring input. Every value was read this session from the cited page or from the project's cached copy of EIA's bulk file; vintages differ (2024 to 2026) and are stated per row, and must not be combined into one 'current' picture. National aggregates only: no facility row, and no nuclear figure other than national generation. The ministry, ADNOC, DEWA, the federal statistics centre and OPEC were not machine-readable on this date, so no figure is taken from them directly. See docs/countries/AE_SOURCE_AUDIT.md.

significance: Petroleum and other liquids made up 78% of the UAE's primary energy production in 2024 and natural gas 19%, with no coal production (EIA).
The UAE produced 3.8 million b/d of crude oil and condensate in 2025, and 4.3 million b/d of petroleum and other liquids (EIA).
In 2024 an estimated 71% of UAE electricity was generated from natural gas, 23% from nuclear and 5% from renewables and other sources (EIA).
The UAE consumed more natural gas than it produced in 2024 and both imports and exports gas (EIA).
EIA reports five operating refineries with a combined capacity of 1,249 thousand b/d as of January 2026.
